equation_summary: Score s_ij = scale * q_i k_j^T + (gc_i - gc_j) where gc = cumsum(logsigmoid(f)) is the cumulative per-head log forget gate; causal (optionally windowed) mask; softmax over keys; output = softmax @ v. This is a K1 reduction whose score carries a non-pairwise cumulative-log-gate additive term, not plain softmax with a fixed bias. The layer computes f = logsigmoid(f_proj(x)) externally and passes it to the mixer; decode uses attn_decoding_one_step with the same cumulative gate.
state_shape: external KV cache plus cached gate f [B,T,HQ]
gate_scope: data-dependent per-head scalar log-decay (cumulative sum enters pairwise score)
